item.title: Tons of plastic sparkle into Christmas attraction in La Castellana
item.description: Thousands of residents including those from nearby cities and towns were treated to an early fun-filled holiday experience as the local government switched on its Christmas display over the weekend. item.title: Gov. Lacson meets with Tourism Sec. Puyat
item.description: Governor Bong Lacson met with Tourism Secretary Bernadette Puyat in Silay City, this morning, and talked on the province’s initiatives on tourism recovery. Also present in the meeting DOT Region VI Director, Cristine Mansinares, Silay City Mayor Mark Golez, Negros Occ. Tourism Officer Cheryl Decena, Ramon Uy, Jr., and Solomon Locsin, among others. #AbanseNegrense
